title: Chapter 100 Wu Qing'S Strength Reaches Star Level
content:
Chapter 100 Wu Qing'S Strength Reaches Star Level

Nearly 100,000 troops of various races outside the city left quickly, and the outside world returned to peace.

Wu Qing was quite satisfied that there was no uncontrollable large-scale war. The crisis was resolved, and the main focus of the Zerg returned to escorting the transport team.

After the Queen's precise calculation, the last batch of transport teams that could normally arrive in Daxia Territory set out from the city, and more than two-thirds of the supplies in the city were left.

At the current transportation speed, it will take at least two days to transport all the supplies in the city back to Daxia Territory.

…

In Daxia Territory, the spacious temporary storage point for supplies in the new city was filled with all kinds of supplies transported.

All the two thousand worker bees of the Zerg have returned here, constantly transferring the supplies from the temporary storage point to the underground warehouse for storage. In the safe area of the territory, they can work day and night to complete the transfer task as soon as possible.

In the underground space of the new city, the warehouses dug by the Zerg are tall, solid and wide, and the temperature and humidity conditions are also excellent, which can store various materials for a long time.

In some warehouses, the worker bees have transferred a lot of materials, and the various materials are classified and stacked in an orderly manner.

With these material reserves, Daxia Territory will not be short of materials for a long time.

A large number of parasites settled in Daxia Territory after transporting the last batch of materials today. They will all become the people of Daxia Territory and participate in various construction projects in Daxia Territory.

The transport personnel of other alliance territories need to return to their own territories. Daxia Territory really cannot accommodate so many people.

Under the guidance of the Queen of the Zerg, Hu Tu led people to select some suitable materials from the vast amount of materials, divided them into small gifts, and gave them as extra rewards to the personnel of each alliance territory who participated in the transportation. This made the transport personnel who were tired all day very happy and looked forward to tomorrow's transportation task.

With the addition of parasites, the population of Daxia Territory has increased again, and Hu Tu's work has become busier.

Wu Qing was almost always behind the scenes in the actual management of the entire Daxia Territory, and would not personally come forward. It was Hu Tu who took charge under the guidance of the Queen of Insects. With the identity of a younger brother recognized by the lord, no one would disobey him because of his young age.

Hu Tu also lived up to Wu Qing's expectations. He was diligent and studious, and had already become a manager. He could handle all kinds of things beautifully. From time to time, he would have some small ideas of his own, and the Queen of Insects also let him play on his own.

Wu Qing was going to be busy during this period. When the new city of Daxia Territory was built, he would let Hu Tu follow Hu Wei, the lord of Hujiaqiu, to study for a while.

As a member of the same clan, Hu Tu should be able to learn more from Hu Wei.

…

As the sky gradually darkened, the battlefield of the decisive battle of the camp was finally cleared before dark, and a large amount of supplies were transported back to the nearby territory of the Tengu clan for storage.

The tribesmen who died in the battle of each tribe were transported away by the tribesmen one after another, and those who did not have time to be transported were also transported to the shelter area of the territory in batches for temporary storage.

On the entire battlefield, only the bodies of the dead soldiers of the evil god camp were still burning. The raging fire turned everything into dust and moistened the land under their feet.

In the coming year, this land will become particularly fertile.

A large number of cleanup personnel began to evacuate, and many of them withdrew to the military camps and garrison territories of the evil god camp occupied by the Tengu clan. They will spend the night in these places and continue to move the supplies stored in these military camps and garrison territories tomorrow.

The Tengu clan withdrew nearly 100,000 surviving territory troops, which did not have a great impact on their strength. The troops in these territories that were beaten were originally prepared to withdraw to rest.

Now that there is a Zerg army on the side, the Tengu clan must be worried about the lack of these territorial remnants. A large number of Tengu clan’s direct troops rushed to reinforce to ensure the Tengu clan’s military advantage in this area.

The evil god camp has a city with hundreds of thousands of soldiers near the Great Xia Territory. It is conceivable that the Tengu tribe also has a lot of reserve forces. There is no problem in sending some direct troops to maintain the military advantage over the Zerg.

From the attitude of each territory towards the Tengu tribe, it can be seen that the Tengu tribe must be able to easily crush them in terms of strength, which can make them surrender.

This so-called camp decisive battle should be a game between the two sides in terms of military strength, material supply, territory maintenance, etc., not a battle in which both sides put all their resources.

After such a camp war, there will be no war of this scale in this area in a short time.

Wu Qing analyzed the intelligence collected from both camps and had some understanding and speculation about these situations.

In the city occupied by the Zerg, the original Zerg army and the elite of the alliance continued to garrison to guard against various emergencies.

In the new city of the Great Xia Territory, there are no powerful Zerg defense buildings in the Zerg territory, and the defense depends entirely on the army.

Now there are more people here, and a large amount of supplies are stored, the situation has become more complicated, Wu Qing dispatched a large number of Zerg troops from the Zerg territory to defend.

Everything was arranged properly, and all the troops and personnel who went out returned to the territory, and the sky was completely dark.

At night, the outside world became a strange world.

…

After the routine Zerg activities of attracting and fighting ghosts were over, Wu Qing's consciousness returned to his body.

Wu Qing's body took out the Lord's Scepter of the Great Xia Territory in the Zerg territory. The Great Xia Territory and the Zerg territory are two sides of the same coin, and the Lord's Scepter can be placed in the Zerg territory.

Wu Qing could feel that since the large-scale transportation of materials to Daxia Territory, the basic luck of Daxia Territory has been increasing rapidly.

The basic luck of this territory is protected by the world rules. The lord cannot use it, and the system will not rob it.

The increase in the basic luck of the territory represents the strengthening of the territory's foundation, the development and progress of the territory, and the achievements made by the lord.

The lord has achieved results, which is rewarded.

Wu Qing felt that his own luck was constantly increasing, and the invisible bottleneck that blocked his strength improvement had disappeared. As long as he wanted, he could increase his strength to one star at any time.

Wu Qing still practiced a systematic practice system. This is not a kind of practice, but a complete system involving the essence of practice and the essence of combat, which can adapt to the practice under the restrictions of various world rules.

Body refining, Qi refining, spirit refining, martial arts and various practice methods are only part of this practice system.

Wu Qing had conducted in-depth research on the system's cultivation system. With a thought, his essence, qi, and spirit all broke through the limitations of the world rules. With the support of the system's resources, he quickly reached the limit of one-star strength.

After casually performing a set of body-refining punches, Wu Qing felt that his combat power had been greatly enhanced. With the dual blessing of mental power and energy, his body was like a fighting and killing machine, which could exert terrifying lethality.

He called a puppy to test it. Wu Qing just punched it lightly, and cracks appeared on the puppy's blade arm and shell.

"My combat power should be much stronger than that of ordinary one-star creatures."
